Title: HOKA Speedgoat 2 Men's Trail Shoes - Black/Brown
Description:
Truly designed to go the extra mile, the Hoka One One Speedgoat 2 is inspired by Karl Meltzer, the runner who holds the record for the most 100-mile trail race wins. His competitive spirit and drive are reflected in the Speedgoat 2, which combines aggressive traction patterns in the outsole with soft cushioning, so you can attack any terrain in comfort, from mile one to 100.

  • Open, engineered mesh upper for a breathable, lightweight fit and feel.
  • Oversize EVA midsole for plush comfort with every step.
  • Vibram MegaGrip outsole delivers unmatched traction, thanks to multidirectional 5mm lugs that dig in to uneven terrain and keep you running strong.
  • Wt. 9.8 oz.

When trails get technical and the miles stack up, the HOKA Speedgoat 2 is engineered to keep you moving with confidence. Inspired by Karl Meltzer, the record holder for the most 100-mile trail race wins, this shoe channels elite endurance into every outing, pairing relentless grip with the plush cushioning HOKA is built on. Whether you're navigating loose shale, slick roots, or long climbs, the Speedgoat 2 delivers the protection and traction to attack any terrain from mile one to 100.

  • Open, engineered mesh upper provides a breathable, lightweight fit that stays comfortable over long distances.
  • Oversized EVA midsole delivers plush cushioning that absorbs impact on rocky descents and uneven singletrack.
  • Vibram MegaGrip outsole with multidirectional 5mm lugs digs into loose dirt, gravel, and technical terrain for unmatched grip.
  • Lightweight build at just 9.8 oz keeps your stride feeling effortless mile after mile.

Cushioning & Road Feel

The oversized EVA midsole is the core of the Speedgoat 2's ride, absorbing the punishment of rocky trails and steep descents while keeping each foot strike feeling soft and controlled. The Vibram MegaGrip outsole works in tandem to translate that cushioned comfort into confident ground feel, giving you the feedback and stability to push harder on everything from fire roads to technical alpine terrain.

Description:
Faithful, reliable, and revolutionary, the Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 41 is unlike any other Peg that has ever been made before. Built with the same internal materials and padding as its predecessor, these running silhouettes are here to push the running world forward while still putting your wants and needs on top of the priority list. The two Zoom Air units combined with the Nike ReactX foam promise you a bouncy, springy sensation and an energised feel at toe-off. Interesting fact: the Nike ReactX foam is engineered to reduce carbon footprints by at least 43%, so you can take a stride towards a sustainable future. Whether you're logging long marathon miles or squeezing in a speed session before the sun goes down, you can put your faith in the Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 41—day after day, run after run.

Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 41 features:

  • Engineered mesh upper feels lightweight and breathable.
  • Broadened forefoot and heel width leave space for the springy Zoom Air engine to deliver a cushioned ride.
  • Implemented midfoot band offers a more secure but forgiving sensation.
  • Midfoot strap provides a moulded fit that is shaped for all-sized arches.

Built for everything from easy miles to busy days on your feet, this pair delivers the light, cushioned ride runners love without feeling overly soft. The Nike Air Zoom Pegasus 41 updates the trusted Peg formula with a breathable engineered mesh upper, dual Zoom Air units, and responsive ReactX foam for smooth comfort on runs, walks, and everyday wear.

  • Engineered mesh upper for lightweight breathability.
  • Dual Zoom Air units help add springy responsiveness.
  • ReactX foam provides soft, energized cushioning.
  • Broadened forefoot and heel create a stable platform.
  • Midfoot band and strap help secure the fit.

Size & Fit Guidance

Most reviewers say the fit feels true to size and secure. For the best fit, we recommend starting with your usual size, or going up half a size if you prefer extra toe room, wear thicker socks, or want a little more space through the forefoot. Runners with narrow feet often like the locked-in feel.

Best For

Best for everyday training, treadmill sessions, walking, and all-day wear when you want one shoe that feels light, cushioned, and dependable.

Cushioning & Road Feel

Reviewers consistently describe the ride as lightweight, bouncy, and supportive, with enough cushioning for distance without losing control of the road. It lands in a balanced sweet spot for runners who want shock absorption and smooth turnover instead of an overly high, ultra-soft feel.

Break-In & Durability

Most reviewers found them comfortable from the first wear, with little to no break-in needed. Over time, the upper and cushioning continue to feel supportive for regular runs, walking routines, and repeated miles.
